---
name: Note Errata
about: Flag a mathematical typo, formula error, or outdated reference in a course monograph
title: "[ERRATA] "
labels: errata, documentation
---

## Note Path
- **Repository Path or Route:** (e.g., `content/Main Notes/2nd Year/Term 3/CSARCH2/Module 01 - .../Note.md` or `/notes/CSARCH2/...`)

## Course and Module
- **Course Code:** (e.g., `CSARCH2`, `CSOPESY`, `NSETRON`)
- **Module / Chapter:** (e.g., `Module 02 - Pipelining`)

## What Is Wrong
Quote the exact passage, equation, table cell, or assessment question containing the error.

## Proposed Correction
Provide the corrected derivation, formula, prose, or answer key rationale.

## Reference / Source
Cite the textbook, lecture slide, RFC, datasheet, or formal proof supporting this correction.
